code: const count=ctx.count||15; const cx=ctx.x||0; const cy=ctx.y||0; const col=ctx.color||'#FFD700'; for(let i=0;i<count;i++){ const ffx = cx + (Math.sin(i*47.3+3.1)*0.5+0.5)*80 + Math.sin(mt*0.7+i*0.97)*12; const ffy = cy + (Math.sin(i*83.7+7.3)*0.5+0.5)*60 + Math.cos(mt*0.5+i*1.3)*8; const ffop = 0.2 + Math.sin(mt*2+i*1.1)*0.3; const ffr = 1.5 + Math.sin(mt*1.5+i*0.8)*0.8; svg += `<circle cx="${ffx}" cy="${ffy}" r="${ffr}" fill="${col}" opacity="${ffop}"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="${ffx}" cy="${ffy}" r="${ffr*3}" fill="${col}" opacity="${ffop*0.1}"/>`; } return svg;
